d: Deep plum-colored hair flows in long, straight strands reaching the floor, featuring a partial updo secured with small purple floral ornaments and long, sweeping bangs. The eyes are a matching shade of deep plum with a serene, knowing expression, set on a face with the maturity of a young adult. The build is slender and graceful, dressed in a combination of a white lace-trimmed bodice and a voluminous, flowing white skirt, partially covered by a heavy, deep red cloak draped over the shoulders. Accessories include a delicate white choker and a small, dark rectangular sign held in the hand, with plantigrade feet.
